sloka: नारदः पर्वतश्चैव गौतमश्च महायशाः ।कात्यायनः सुयज्ञश्च ह्यगस्त्यस्तपसां निधिः ।। ७.९६.५ ॥
transliteration: nāradaḥ parvataścaiva gautamaśca mahāyaśāḥ ।kātyāyanaḥ suyajñaśca hyagastyastapasāṁ nidhiḥ ।। 7.96.5 ॥

translations.english: Narada, Parvata, the highly renowned Gautama, Katyayana, Suyajna, and Agastya, a treasure-house of austerities, were also present.
